summary: the cases of tests/run ext2 under etude, against a mount's check that counts no lost block, a statfs that gives a magic number other than ext2's, and a recovery init that checks the partitions of the first disk alone

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 rach2-recovery utils && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel utils/sbin/init-recovery && mkdir -p ${WORK}/recovery && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK}/recovery rach2-recovery/kernel

faults.name: lost-uncounted
faults.summary: the mount's check takes a block the bitmap marks used and no file has for one in use, so that it calls the volume clean and leaves the error bit clear

faults.name: magic
faults.summary: statfs gives KRFFS's magic number for an ext2 volume, which vfsprobe finds on the ext2 root

faults.name: first-disk
faults.summary: recovery's init under rach2.fsck runs e2fsck on the partitions of the first disk alone, so that the damaged copy on the second is never repaired
